newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai interbank rate steady, baht down late.
newsitem.headline: Thai interbank rate steady, baht down late.

text.p: The Thai overnight interbank rate was quoted at 9.25-9.50 percent in late trade on Thursday compared with 9.50 percent earlier and 9.00-9.50 late on Wednesday, dealers said.
"The market liquidity was still high. But the reserve requirement tomorrow has hampered banks' willingness to lend their excess funds," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
They expect the rate to continue in a narrow range. The central bank requires all commercial banks to meet a reserve requirement on the seventh and 22nd of each month.
The baht was down slightly to 25.419-25.424 to the dollar in late thin trade from 25.415-25.420 early, dealers said.
"The market volume was thin today in line with the directionless dollar against major currencies," said one currency dealer.
The one-month dollar/baht swap premium was quoted at 9.00/10.00 satangs per dollar late compared with 8.50/9.50 in early morning.
The dollar/baht mid-rate was fixed at 25.41 against 25.43 on Wednesday. -- Anuchit Nguyen (662) 652-0642
